title: Cover AI agent tool latency with fillers
summary: Play localized filler phrases or a hosted wait file while a slow AI agent tool finishes.
scenario: A parts desk checking a slow inventory system

evidence: demo housecall trenton.py:406 wait_file (legacy SDK 1.0.x - re-verify against 3.0.1)
sdk agent_base.py:905-924 renders wait_file, fillers, wait_file_loops on the function entry
sdk ai_config_mixin.py:140-146 both filler kinds must be passed or the deprecated `fillers` key renders
schema.json FunctionFillers is oneOf single-language objects; a two-key dict fails validation (verified 2026-09-01)
